evidence: Added tests/dashboard/test_endpoint_shapes.py and 37 fixtures under tests/dashboard/fixtures/. UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 rewrites fixtures. Cases: GET token, snapshot, phase (4), task (4), journal (2), record (2), requirement (4), needs (6 kinds), backlog (2); POST needs (approve, reject, accept, sign), POST backlog (dismiss, promote); error shapes (404 task, phase, needs; 400 note required; 400 unsupported action). Extra tests: every fixture has a case; every /api route has a case. pytest tests/dashboard/test_endpoint_shapes.py: 39 passed, 7 consecutive runs; test_web_dashboard and test_web_fastapi_writes 14 passed; ruff clean; basedpyright 0 errors. No source code changed.
observations: Reject on an open continuity-question builds finding subject plan-rejected:<scope> and canon rejects a scope with spaces (latent bug in _question_reject_args in dismiss.py; not changed). The model sorts by recorded_at alone, which ties within one second.
